HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.title: Ares
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0-0r: I must say you deal death rather exquisitely. Though, perhaps I could be of some further assistance in such matters, yes?
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1-0r: Ah! I figured that you must have been the source of all that bloodshed underneath the earth. Let me see if I can make your death-dealing a little more efficient.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2-0r: Well, my hell-born kin, my blessing now is yours to do with as you wish; provided you inflict a little suffering for me?
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3-0r: I've just the thing for you this time, my kin. May I present my instruments of pain?
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.4-0r: I surely hope your bloodshed's going well, and long that there shall be no end to it. I am, as ever, here to serve your benefit.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.5-0r: How fares your endless war against the dead? Let it be known that I am happy to take sides in such affairs. Please, I insist!
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.6-0r: Death rears its head in all too many forms, I'm sure you know. Though you may never find them all, I nonetheless encourage you to try.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.7-0r: The wretched dead you face perhaps forget themselves. Go, then, remind them of the agony which brought them to your realm.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.8-0r: Life and death are inextricable, and war is often what connects the two. Don't you agree?
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.9-0r: This world has a limitless capacity for pain; and so, it truly is no inconvenience to help you to bring out a little more.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.10-0: The living and the dead alike desire what I represent. Their appetite for bloodshed cannot easily be sated. A goal to strive for, no?
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.11-0: Perhaps the dead you stand against have long forgotten the experience of anguish and despair. I trust that you shall soon remind them for me?
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.12-0: Beautiful, isn't it? The strife which follows you. You have a real knack for this, and I for one am happy to assist.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.13-0: Some would question the destruction which you sow, but I shall never do so. I fully understand your impulses. Allow me to indulge them.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.14-0: Do you suppose the dead feel pain unlike the living? This is for me an endless fascination, so go on, and give me more to think about.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.15-0: As you continue waging war against the dead, I gladly lend you my support; family to family, no questions asked.
HADESANCIENTS-ARES_ANCIENT.talk.firstVis: Ah, a fellow student of death! To have confronted the Architect with such zeal. My kin insisted that I act upon the violence spiralling out of control, and I do wish to see your prowess, so here ... a first of many contributions to the cause.
